navigation.status: Source baseline measured; composed opening adaptation awaits actual coder gait result
routeLimitations: Baseline hall console blocks the 2m hall at z0.925..1.275; recorded prototype relocation needed before claiming an entrance route.
Baseline stair newels reduce clear width to .935m; the .5m-radius conservative profile does not fit. Actual raw goat diameter .880311482m fits geometrically; coder owns the safe traversal envelope.
At 90 degrees the native leaf reduces the measured clear throat below1m; preserve this measured width rather than silently widening.

adaptations: Closed .12 m floor slab faces are inferred from the real oak support; source surfaces stay at .48 and2.60m.
Only buried hip-roof faces inside the gambrel union are removed; visible native roof forms are retained.
Oil and coal stores are explicit prototype placements; finite quantities and finishes are game parameters.
Canonical wall patches include actual partial opening panels and never fill the stair notch.
sourceGaps: Native door clearance pending measured passage result.
The original floor meshes have no closed slab/ceiling volume.
Some baseline rugs overhang the oak edge; fuel support references use actual overlap, not their rectangular reservation.
